rows.note: Use this all-purpose construction when someone gets onto or boards a vehicle, such as 上船, 上車, or 上機.

example.english: Hurry and get aboard the boat—the boat is about to leave.
example.jyutping: faai3 di1 soeng5 syun4 baan1 syun4 zau6 hoi1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when describing someone or something already on board the vehicle rather than getting onto it.

example.english: They are already aboard the train.
example.traditional: 佢哋已經喺架火車上喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ji5 ging1 hai2 gaa3 fo2 ce1 soeng6 laa3

rows.note: Use this all-purpose construction when someone boards or gets into a vehicle, such as 上船 or 上車.

example.english: Hurry up and get aboard the bus—the bus is leaving!
example.traditional: 快啲上巴士啦，架車就開喇！
example.jyutping: faai3 di1 soeng5 baa1 si6 laa1 gaa3 ce1 zau6 hoi1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when describing someone or something as being aboard or inside a vehicle rather than boarding it.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 hai2 syun4 soeng6 min6 laa3
